description: OpenPatch wire v1 scenarios of a real cup pod (Nfp608_26_45CupMiter1_1 = DRIVE_CAL id 0x26, production STRICT config), generated by firmware-rs/openpatch-core/tests/wire_vectors.rs and consumed by ios/OpenPatchKit/OpenPatchCore/Tests/OpenPatchCoreTests/WireGoldenTests.swift. Plaintext frames (header, TLV, real CRC-16); every command carries TIME_OF_DAY_MS = 43200000 as its FIRST tag. All bytes are hex. Steps are in order: the pod state evolves from step to step.
